en-US.description:
Three people who overcame unjust oppression and proved the truth have reunited.

Song Young-gil, Han Yeon-hee, and Jang Jeong-min, who have designed the future of Baengnyeongdo and Ganghwa together since their time as Mayors of Incheon, have now transcended mere candidates to become "victorious comrades" who have overcome trials together. The golden time to realize the development of Ganghwa and Ongjin is right now.

We will move forward with the single step of three people, which is more precious than ten steps by one person. We will pour all our strength into ensuring that the victory of this "One Team," which began in Incheon, leads to a victory for the entire Republic of Korea, and furthermore, becomes the most reliable driving force supporting the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration.

id.description:
Tiga orang yang mengatasi penindasan yang tidak adil dan membuktikan kebenaran telah bersatu kembali.

Song Young-gil, Han Yeon-hee, dan Jang Jeong-min, yang telah merancang masa depan Baengnyeongdo dan Ganghwa bersama sejak masa jabatan mereka sebagai Walikota Incheon, kini telah melampaui sekadar kandidat untuk menjadi "kawan seperjuangan" yang telah mengatasi cobaan bersama. Waktu emas untuk mewujudkan pembangunan Ganghwa dan Ongjin adalah saat ini.

Kita akan melangkah maju dengan satu langkah tiga orang, yang lebih berharga daripada sepuluh langkah satu orang.
